name: OpenVDB Sparse Tree Allocation on Voxel Activation
definition: When a voxel is activated in an OpenVDB grid, the tree allocates only the nodes along the path to the leaf node containing the coordinate, but initializes all direct children at each level as tiles holding the grid's background value.
summary: OpenVDB Sparse Tree Allocation on Voxel Activation initializes full sibling tiles at every octree level during traversal, causing disproportionate memory bloat compared to standard sparse methods.
